ecid.description: Target specific device by its ECID (hex or decimal). Empty string disables this option.

udid.description: Target specific device by its UDID. Only works with devices in normal mode.

ipsw_path.description: Path to the compressed .ipsw file or directory containing extracted IPSW files.

latest_firmware.description: Use the latest available firmware with on-demand download. PATH argument is ignored.

erase.description: Perform full restore instead of update, erasing all data on the device.

no_input.description: Non-interactive mode. Disables prompts that might prevent data loss.

no_action.description: Do not perform any restore action. Used primarily for downloading IPSWs with --latest.

cache_path.description: Directory for caching extracted or other reused files.

signing_server.description: Override the default signing server request URL.

exclude_nor_baseband.description: Exclude nor/baseband upgrade. Only works with legacy devices or custom firmware.

fetch_shsh.description: Fetch TSS record and save to .shsh file, then exit.

no_restore.description: Do not restore and end after booting to the ramdisk.

plain_progress.description: Print progress as plain step and progress numbers.

variant.description: Use given VARIANT to match the build identity, e.g. 'Customer Erase Install (IPSW)'.

ignore_errors.description: Try to continue the restore process after certain errors. Warning: May render device unable to boot.
